settings.question: What is Rescue Retro Relics?
settings.answer: Rescue Retro Relics (RRR) is a retro-inspired collectibles shop with a mission. Every purchase helps fund dog rescue in the Detroit area. We sell brand-new collectibles and gifts with a nostalgic, throwback feel — think warm, cozy, and fun.

settings.question: What do you sell?
settings.answer: We carry brand-new retro-inspired collectibles, keychains, tote bags, gifts, and novelty items featuring beloved characters and pop culture icons. Everything in our shop is new — not vintage — just designed with that classic nostalgic feel.

settings.question: How does the rescue fundraising work?
settings.answer: A portion of every sale goes toward supporting Detroit-area dog rescue organizations. When you shop RRR, you're not just getting something you love — you're helping a dog find their forever home.

settings.question: Are your items new or vintage?
settings.answer: All items in our shop are brand new — retro-inspired in style but freshly made. No secondhand, no worn edges — just new stuff that feels like it belongs in a better decade.

settings.question: Will you ever carry true vintage items?
settings.answer: Yes! We're planning to add genuine vintage and secondhand finds to the shop in the future. Stay tuned — and follow us on social media so you don't miss it when they drop.

settings.question: Where do you ship?
settings.answer: We ship to the 48 contiguous United States. We do not currently ship to Alaska, Hawaii, or internationally.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Most orders ship within 1–3 business days. Delivery typically takes 3–7 business days depending on your location.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We want you to love your order. If something arrives damaged or isn't right, contact us within 14 days and we'll make it right.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking number by email.

settings.question: How can I contact you?
settings.answer: You can reach us at: stephanie@rescueretrorelics.com or through the Contact page on our website. We're a small operation and respond as fast as we can — usually within 24–48 hours.
